name: Kisan Setu Location Data Contract
description: Defines the State → District → Block → Village data contract. No fake or guessed village records are included.

recommended_primary_source.name: Local Government Directory (LGD)
recommended_primary_source.publisher: Ministry of Panchayati Raj, Government of India
recommended_primary_source.refresh_note: The official OGD catalog describes LGD village/state/district/sub-district resources as being updated monthly.

legacy_reference_source.name: Census 2011 Location Code Directory
legacy_reference_source.publisher: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India
legacy_reference_source.use: Fallback/reference only; not a replacement for current LGD data.

storage_recommendation.preferred_runtime_pattern: Load location options by parent ID (state → district → block → village).
storage_recommendation.preferred_firebase_pattern: Store only the farmer's selected location IDs/codes plus display names in the farmer profile.
storage_recommendation.preferred_import_pattern: Import verified LGD records into a dedicated Firestore collection or serve them through a backend/API.

development_sample.label: DEVELOPMENT DATA — NOT A COMPLETE OR CURRENT INDIA DATASET
development_sample.source: LGD-derived public mirror of the Government of India LGD data

integration_notes: Do not treat development_sample as the full location database.
Village options should remain empty until verified village-level data is imported.
Keep the adapter independent from signup UI so the data source can be replaced later without changing form logic.
